I couldn't find anything about configuring the Django admin site in these FastAPI docs. The Django admin is part of Django, a separate framework, so the FastAPI documentation doesn't cover it.

**What to look for instead:**
- **For the Django admin**, check the official Django documentation, specifically the section on "The Django admin site" (`django.contrib.admin`).
- **For a similar feature in FastAPI**, note that FastAPI doesn't include a built-in admin panel. The closest built-in feature is the automatic API docs UI, which you can customize. For example, you can set fields like `title` | `str` | The title of the API.[5] and a `description` | `str` | A short description of the API.[5]:

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI(
    title="ChimichangApp",
    version="0.0.1",
)
```

For more, see the "Metadata and Docs URLs" page in the FastAPI tutorial.
